headline: Bengaluru couple shares Goa move costs
summary: A couple that left Bengaluru to start afresh in Goa has broken down their living expenses and financial transition. They shared details about how their new lifestyle compares in terms of cost.

headline: Goa to face Bihar in Ranji Trophy
summary: Goa and Bihar are scheduled to lock horns in Match 50 of the Ranji Trophy Elite 2026/27 season. The fixture forms part of the ongoing domestic red-ball cricket calendar.

headline: New Vande Bharat tagged slowest in India
summary: The newly introduced Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Goa Vande Bharat train service is set to become the slowest of its kind in the country. Despite the sluggish pace, it offers passengers scenic views of the Western Ghats.

headline: Vande Bharat route offers Western Ghats views
summary: The Yeshwantpur-Goa Vande Bharat route will provide travelers with scenic glimpses of the Western Ghats during its journey. However, it is also noted as one of India's longest-duration and slowest chair car services.

headline: Notable figures conquer Goa Ironman 70.3
summary: A retired pilot and a Kerala High Court judge successfully completed the grueling Goa Ironman 70.3 challenge. Several other notable participants and local relay teams also finished the demanding endurance event.

headline: Goa Dairy holds milk prices steady
summary: Goa Dairy has decided to maintain its current milk prices even after neighboring Karnataka approved a rate hike. The decision brings relief to local consumers amidst rising market costs.

headline: Questions raised over deleted voters in Goa
summary: Authorities face scrutiny over voter list revisions, with data revealing that about 80 percent of deleted voters are either shifted, untraceable, or disqualified. Concerns have also been raised regarding the demographic breakdown of the removals.

headline: Annamalai finishes Ironman 70.3 in Goa
summary: Politician K Annamalai successfully completed the Ironman 70.3 challenge in Goa, sharing his grueling experience with the public. The event saw strong participation from athletes across the country.

headline: Goa aims for faster destination wedding registration
summary: The Goa government is introducing measures to streamline and expedite marriage registrations for couples opting for destination weddings in the state. The initiative aims to boost ease of compliance for tourism-related weddings.

headline: Army's Biten Singh wins Ironman Goa 2026
summary: Biten Singh of the Indian Army clinched victory at the Ironman 70.3 Goa 2026 event. He successfully completed the course while setting a new record.

headline: Goa college introduces marriage prep course
summary: A college in Goa has launched a specialized course aimed at helping young people prepare for healthy and lasting marriages. The curriculum focuses on relationship management before tying the knot.

headline: Low rainfall leaves paddy crop unaffected
summary: Recent low rainfall levels have had only a limited impact on the paddy crop in Goa. Agricultural authorities continue to monitor weather conditions across the state.

headline: Goa films win big at awards
summary: Two local stories have won prestigious film awards, bringing recognition to Goa's regional cinema industry. The achievement highlights growing creative talent within the state.

headline: Goa to play Pondicherry in Ranji match
summary: Goa is slated to play against Pondicherry in Match 68 of the Ranji Trophy Elite 2026/27 season. The fixture is part of the league stage matches organized by the BCCI.

headline: Vasco market fire damages 150 shops
summary: A massive fire broke out in Vasco’s Sunday Market ahead of Diwali, destroying roughly 150 shops. The Bombay High Court later ordered financial relief for the affected families.

headline: Goa government to approach Supreme Court on ST seats
summary: The Goa government has decided to move the Supreme Court against a High Court order that stalled the Scheduled Tribe seat reservation process ahead of the 2027 polls. A delegation is also set to meet legal officials regarding the matter.

headline: Smart City control centre under fire
summary: The inactive Smart City control centre faced severe criticism from citizens following major traffic chaos in the area. Residents and local bodies pointed to administrative lapses in managing urban mobility.

headline: AAP announces 'Mhargai Mukti Yatra' in Goa
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party is launching a statewide 'Mhargai Mukti Yatra' starting November 26. The campaign targets the ruling government over rising inflation, price hikes, and corruption.

headline: Government bans toxic materials in Narkasur effigies
summary: The Goa government has issued strict warnings against the use of plastic and toxic materials in Narkasur effigies ahead of the celebrations. Authorities are enforcing eco-friendly guidelines across the state.

headline: Sailor from Punjab dies in Polem accident
summary: A sailor hailing from Punjab lost his life in an accidental incident in Polem. Local authorities have registered the case and are investigating the circumstances.

headline: Health fears rise over cancelled well inspections
summary: The sudden cancellation of scheduled well inspections in Comba has sparked health concerns among local residents. Community members are demanding urgent testing of water sources.

headline: GTDC seeks deferment of Ghat Aarti proposal
summary: The Goa Tourism Development Corporation has requested a postponement of its planned Ghat Aarti proposal. Further discussions on the tourism initiative are expected at a later date.

headline: Goa cop accused of sexually assaulting minor
summary: A Goa police officer has been accused of sexually assaulting a minor girl multiple times inside a Crime Branch office. The incident has drawn severe condemnation and swift legal action.

headline: Goa participates in Konkani music convention
summary: Goa has joined a historic Guinness World Record bid as a 12-day nonstop Konkani music convention kicks off in Mangaluru. Multiple cultural delegations from Goa are participating in the global event.

headline: Political shifts as local leaders prepare for 2027
summary: Political alignments are taking shape in Goa as figures like Shirodkar Deepak announce their intentions to contest the Shiroda constituency in the upcoming 2027 assembly elections.

headline: Goa looks to AI to boost tourism economy
summary: The Goa government is planning to integrate artificial intelligence solutions to expand and transform its tourism economy's linguistic capabilities. The initiative aims to better cater to international and diverse travelers.

headline: PWD minister plans cultural festival
summary: Goa's PWD minister has announced plans to organize a Vidarbha Mahotsav to strengthen cultural ties between regions. The festival aims to promote artistic exchanges and community bonding.

headline: Scooter accident claims woman's life in Mandrem
summary: A woman has succumbed to her injuries days after meeting with a scooter accident in Mandrem. Local authorities are reviewing road safety measures following the tragedy.

headline: Multi-crore scam operated from luxury Goa villa
summary: Investigations revealed how a group of young men orchestrated a multi-crore financial scam while operating out of a luxury villa in Goa. Law enforcement agencies uncovered the network following extensive probes.

headline: Margao municipal garden set for revamp
summary: The Margao municipal garden is scheduled to undergo a major infrastructure and aesthetic revamp. The project aims to improve public recreational spaces for residents and visitors.

headline: Major fire breaks out at Kundaim scrap yard
summary: A massive fire erupted at the Saba Scrap Traders yard in Kundaim, gutting the facility. Firefighting teams rushed to the spot to bring the blaze under control.
